description: Review each candidate (a list of patch ops) on its own copy of the spec and keep only those that raise the score without raising any hard count or adding a blocker or major finding. Ops: {op: set, path, value}, {op: unset, path}, {op: add, path, value}, {op: move, path, after|before}, {op: edge, match: a spec edge line or null to append, value: the new line or null to remove}; paths are dotted, for example nodes.db.note. Returns each candidate's score and verdict, then the best patched spec text when one was kept.

candidates.description: Candidate fixes, each a list of patch ops applied in order.

after.description: move: the sibling id to follow.

before.description: move: the sibling id to precede.

match.description: edge: the spec edge line to replace.

path.description: Dotted spec path, for example nodes.api.label.

value.description: The new value (set, add) or edge line (edge); null removes an edge.

name.description: File name stem for outputs: lowercase letters, digits and -. Default: the spec file's name, else diagram.

skin.description: classic (vendor deck look) or stage (dark product look). Default: the spec's skin.

spec.description: The diagram spec as YAML (or JSON) text. Pass this or spec_path, not both.

spec_path.description: Absolute path of a spec file on this machine (stdio only). Its folder resolves relative icons: paths.

width.description: Display width in CSS px. Default 880.

name: try_patches
title: Try spec patches
